name: HappyToHelp
maturity: Owner-installable MIT source release. Local verification and hosted, real-provider and accessibility acceptance are separate; see ACCEPTANCE.md.

spine.record: Project-owned customer conversations with durable messages, evidence and explicitly authorized work.

description: Help your team resolve customer questions with shared conversations and a searchable help center.
nonGoals: Implicit deployment or provider execution from source inspection
Reusing legacy passwords or grants as native authority
Regenerating or erasing original owner checkouts

externals.why: Selected Worker/D1/R2/Queues/DO deployment target. Implementation/configuration source: wrangler.jsonc. No versioned replacement adapter is declared.
Selected AI, semantic/crawl, email, GitHub and branding capabilities. Implementation/configuration source: scripts/deployment/environment.mjs. No versioned replacement adapter is declared.

Optional owner-enabled editor frame; separate Run Edit Run authentication and installation authority are required. Disabled by default. Implementation/configuration source: src/editor/EditorLauncher.tsx. No versioned replacement adapter is declared.
data: Explicitly reviewed text limited to 240 characters

externals.requiredWhen: Saving or enabling workspace webhook or Slack connections
externals.why: Configured workspace receivers including Slack (workspace-receivers) sends to custom destination workspace-connection-version: Owner-selected public HTTPS webhook receivers or the fixed Slack incoming-webhook and chat.postMessage protocols. Customer receivers and Slack are external destinations. Delivery uses platform HTTPS fetch with manual redirects, a finite timeout and byte bounds.
data: Opaque workspace, conversation, message and resolution IDs
Event type, time, revision, outcome and numeric rating
Slack notification with up to 500 characters of the first committed visitor message
